newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-News appoints ceo of STAR TV India.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-News appoints ceo of STAR TV India.

text.p: News Corp Ltd said on Thursday it had appointed Rathikant Basu as chief executive officer of STAR TV India, which is a unit of News Corp's Hong Kong-based satellite TV arm STAR TV.
The global and entertainment group said Basu would be responsible for all STAR TV and News Corp activities in the sub-continent.
"India is one of our company's most important markets and we are proud to have Mr Basu as the leader of our operations there," News Corp chairman Rupert Murdoch said in a statement.
News Corp said Basu had a distinguished career in India's public service and his most recent position was Secretary, Department of Electronics.
It said Gene Swinstead, STAR TV's managing director for India, will continue in his current role, reporting to Basu.
